$comment: ODW config for review-until-clean. Pass with `odw run review-and-correct --config ~/.odw/review-config.json`. Reviewer agents run `git diff` and read touched files themselves, so their adapter MUST have tools enabled -- ODW's built-in `omp` adapter ships `--no-tools`, which yields a hallucinated review rather than an error. An adapter entry replaces the built-in wholesale, so the whole command is restated here. Adapters not listed (codex, claude, cursor, kilo, opencode, gemini, qwen, kimi) are tool-capable as shipped.
